title: Shadcn
description: Runs the shadcn CLI (npx shadcn@latest <action> [--preset=<preset>] [args]) against this project's root, where components.json lives.

action.description: shadcn CLI command to run. Defaults to "add" (not set as a schema default, so legacy args like "add button" can be detected).

preset.description: Preset passed as --preset=<preset>. Only supported with the "init" or "apply" action.

args.description: Arguments passed after the action, e.g. "button", "button card dialog", "--yes". For backwards compatibility, if no action is given and args starts with a shadcn command (e.g. "add button", "diff"), args is passed through as-is.
